blocks.text: KHARTOUM, Sudan — Drones struck Sudan’s capital, Khartoum, damaging residential homes and a United Nations building on Sunday, witnesses and the world organization said. Explosions were heard in the area around Khartoum airport and other parts of the city from around 2 a.m. until approximately 4:30 a.m. A drone strike completely destroyed a house, a witness said, while a Sudanese army source said the drones had been launched from Ethiopia. “The drone attack at dawn today is a continuation of Ethiopian aggression against Sudanese territory, as the drones were launched from Ethiopia’s Bahir Dar airport,” the source told AFP.
